label: Honey and cockroaches on the preachers' lips, babies across the land
description: Sticky oily honey coming off the preachers' mouths with cockroaches crawling in and out and resting on their lips, and babies in diapers from sea to shining sea, because a milk gospel is being preached rather than the meat of the word. Given as the reason the culture changed and the elections went as they did, in America and worldwide. Unfalsifiable in form, but the image is stable across tellings.
aliases: cockroaches were coming in and out of the mouth
There was babies upon the land

label: A communist party rising in South Korea, and a dragon pulling it in
description: A communist party trying to rise in South Korea as bad as North Korea's, arriving gradually like a frog in a pot, with China working through North Korea and drawing in South Korea and Taiwan like a mother hen gathering chicks, and a dragon over the country trying to take its freedoms. The June 2025 election returned a liberal rather than a communist government, which is the nearest test.
aliases: a communist party trying to rise up in Korea
like a mother hen tries to bring in her chicklets
a dragon that would try to pull them into communism

label: Three weeks without electricity on the east coast after a Chinese cyber attack
description: Major power outages from Chinese cyber attacks leaving some cities without electricity for three weeks, mainly on the east coast, with the whole infrastructure melting down, alongside shortages of car parts and computer chips. Three weeks is a hard number, and the longest American blackouts from any cause have been storm-related and shorter.
aliases: people without electricity in some cities for three weeks
major cyber attacks coming from China
it caused the whole infrastructure to melt down

label: A depression over China lifts the iron curtain for a season
description: A depression over China brought on by pride in the tariff wars, which lifts the iron curtain so that a wave comes through an open door for a season, like a curtain pulled back that can be walked through for a short time, with uprisings following in China, Asia, Canada and Australia. The Pharaoh framing means hardening is expected first, so worsening conditions confirm it rather than refuting it.
aliases: a depression causes the iron curtain to be lifted
That window was open for a season

label: Millions flee the coasts for the I-35 corridor
description: Millions of people coming soon to the I-35 corridor down to Fort Worth because they are fleeing what is going to happen on the east and west coasts, with a wealthy man having already bought and renovated a property there on the strength of the coming revival. Texas already leads the country in net domestic in-migration, so only an unusual surge would count.
aliases: from the I-35 corridor clear down to Fort Worth
millions of people come here soon
fleeing what's going to happen on the East Coast

label: God is about to touch America's money
description: He is told that money is America's god and that God is about to touch the money, which he says he does not know how will happen, with a window given first for those who are listening. Touch the money is broad enough that inflation, a market fall or a banking event would all fit.
aliases: I'm about to touch the money
If you touch their money, it freaks them out
